properties.name: Key Route Pier terminal
properties.geometry_method: Traced by eye from USGS San Francisco 1:62,500 (1915) (1 hand-read points); the sheet corrected by a shift on 3 control points (Yerba Buena Island on the 1949 Oakland West sheet; +74 m E, +213 m N, RMS 44.8 m). The ferry terminal building at the pier's west end.

properties.name: San Pablo Avenue
properties.geometry_method: Given outright. Where the 1949 sheet marks "Sta" at San Pablo Avenue.

sources.note: "the station at the crossing of San Pablo Avenue"

properties.name: Piedmont (40th Street and Piedmont Avenue)
properties.geometry_method: At today's corner of 40th Street and Piedmont Avenue; checked on USGS Oakland West 1:24,000 (1949). "on Piedmont avenue, between Fortieth and Forty-first streets": drawn at today's corner of 40th Street and Piedmont Avenue.
properties.notes: The Piedmont line's terminal until it was extended in 1924.
